rationale: P characterises the vehicle braking behaviour that must be evaluated to determine whether unintended braking is prevented under SG-3. H-3 establishes the operational conditions and the hazardous stopping event. FR-7 supports distinguishing intended obstacle-avoidance braking from unintended braking. P does not expand into the sensing, computation, communication, failure-mitigation, or timing mechanisms that may influence braking.
determining_elements: “Whether braking occurs as intended or unintentionally” directly addresses the Evaluation Target rather than merely describing an influencing mechanism.
The straight-ahead urban-road situation at 50 km/h, in good weather and without visible obstacles or vehicles ahead, matches H-3's operational situation.
Braking and non-braking are relevant behavioural states for evaluating prevention of unintended braking.

Obstacle-related braking is expressly limited to situations within the declared scope and supplies the intended-braking contrast supported by FR-7; obstacle-detection mechanisms are not incorporated into P.
